name: SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-version:
    name: Validate tag matches pyproject.toml version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install pyyaml
        run: pip install pyyaml
      - name: Get version from pyproject.toml
        id: get_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(python -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml'))['tool']['poetry']['version'])")
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Validate tag matches version
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          if [ "$TAG" != "${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match version ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
            exit 1
          fi

  sdk-generate:
    name: Validate SDK generation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: pip install hatch pyyaml
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm
      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: python scripts/generate_sdk.py
      - name: SDK generation succeeded
        run: echo "SDK generation succeeded"

  python-publish:
    name: Publish Python package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Install build
        run: pip install build
      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build
      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.10.2
        with:
          user: __token__
          password: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}

  typescript-publish:
    name: Publish TypeScript SDK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm
      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Build SDK
        run: pnpm run build
      - name: Publish to npm
        uses: JS-DevTools/npm-publish@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          package: ./sdk
